This land no be my own, I just dey rent am, so I no fit spend too much money on top. For my cassava and yam here for South South, the soil still get small strength, but I go add small NPK to help the tubers swell well. I get goat and kitchen waste wey I dey gather, so I go spread am for the plot before planting. I go use the cassava stems and yam setts wey I save from last season — no money for hybrid seed, and local one dey do well for here. Rain dey plenty for our side, so I no need irrigation; me and my daughter go do most of the work, but I go call small hired hand for ridging and weeding.
